title: EthXY World
tagline: Forge your legend. Pixel MMORPG on Base. Raid monsters, engage in open world
description: Expansion of EthXY into a full MMORPG with open world engagement.  Grow stronger as you collect better gear, raid monsters, go on adventures with other players.  With attributes such as Strength, Intelligence, Stamina, and Agility that dictate onchain fighting performance, it brings a special feeling of owning your own character.
how_its_made: Uses onchain Base contracts to handle character creation, asset accounting, items as NFT's.  Utilizes cheap Base gas fees to make onchain what would traditionally be in a closed game state environment.  Onchain's core feature is the feeling of direct ownership and agency.  EthXY expands this feeling as its core thesis.
